postReviewAmendment.proofInterpretation: F1 fails on unmodified 14f73d06 and passes patched. F2/F3 are test gaps, not broken implementation: their new assertions pass on 14f73d06 and patched; RV-10 and RV-07 fail them. All three targeted regression mutations fail on the patched test suite. No assertion failure is fabricated for the correct old-head F2/F3 behavior.
carryForwards: - CF-LSC1S-1 (-> LSC-1): the local-seats route must obtain the service via getLocalSeatCredentialService() so the operator window is genuinely route-wide; add a route test that two requests on different seats share one window and that no address/header reaches the service. Never construct LocalSeatCredentialService in the route.

- CF-LSC1S-2 (-> LSC-1): request schema must enforce a non-empty (recommend >= 8, matching the vault route) seat password, label 1-64 non-blank, operation id 1-128 non-blank, and an integer expectedGeneration before calling the service, so CHECK failures do not surface as 'internal-error' after the window and KDF were consumed (L3). Consider a pre-read of the operation row and generation before keygen (L1).

- CF-LSC1S-3 (-> LSC-1): one-in-flight mint per seat, mint-vs-revoke post-check (re-read generation and revoked_at after both KDF and signing; refuse with the revoked-seat code), locked-seat refusal before KDF, and whether locked/concurrent refusals consume the mint window; recordFailure/clearFailures with service.now() and the mint's start generation (P5 shows the substrate behaves).

- CF-LSC1S-4 (-> LSC-2OP): the outcome's generation (after F1) is the value to seed the next expectedGeneration; mint a fresh operation id per submit; a 'generation-conflict' detail.currentGeneration must refresh the form, never auto-retry.
- CF-LSC1S-5 (-> LSC-1 / later): decide whether 'internal-error' should log error.name only (L2); keep message/cause out of logs.
- CF-LSC1S-6 (-> LSC-1 review): re-run RV-02/RV-10/RV-16-style mutants on the mint path (no-store header, no password in URL/log/error, decrypted seat key zero-filled after signing).

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1S-1 -> LSC-1: the route uses the singleton service, so one window is shared, and no address or header reaches the service.

Never construct LocalSeatCredentialService in the route.

LSC-1.rules: Singleton route service; strict input schema; one in-flight mint; post-KDF and post-sign generation/revocation fences; locked-seat refusal before KDF; window consumption; runtime R2-01..14 coverage and named downstream limits.
